subject: Proposal: NarrowBand renewal — staged uplift + sandboxed burst capacity
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@narrowband.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@narrowband.ai>
Cc: procurement@narrowband.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: NarrowBand renewal — staged uplift + sandboxed burst capacity

Hi Olivia / Tom,

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, attached is a compact amendment that lets NarrowBand expand mid-contract while keeping your renewal co-term intact. High level: a staged uplift that splits the increase over three months (to smooth invoice impact), plus a small pool of sandboxed burst capacity for testing new features without impacting prod buckets.

Key bullets:
- Staged uplift: +40% additional units, applied 50% / 30% / 20% across three months.
- Co-term: amendment preserves existing renewal date (Dec 31) and annualizes added capacity for next year's baseline.
- Burst sandbox: 200k tokens/month reserved for dev / staging (no additional seat charges), billed only if used at standard pay-as-you-go rates.
- One-time onboarding credit: $12k to offset migration work and early usage.

I've included the proposed amendment (PDF) and recent usage exports so you can validate the sizing. If this looks directionally right, can we lock a call tomorrow to walk procurement through the invoice phasing?

Best,
Grace

Subject: Re: Proposal: NarrowBand renewal — staged uplift + sandboxed burst capacity

Grace,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clear bullets. A couple of procurement questions before we loop legal:
1) Can you show the effective blended unit price across the three-month stagger? We need to justify the uplift to finance.
2) Is the sandbox burst bucket capped per repo / team, or shared across NarrowBand? We'd prefer it scoped to a separate billing tag to avoid surprises.
3) Any flexibility on the one-time onboarding credit — could that be split into two invoices tied to milestones?

Also — our CFO wants the uplift to convert to a baseline at 75% utilization of the extra units, not 100%. Is that something we can model into the amendment (i.e., grace utilization threshold to annualize)?

Would you be available Wed 10am PT for a 30-min call with procurement and finance?

Thanks,
Olivia Harper
Head of Product Operations, NarrowBand Inc
olivia.harper@narrowband.ai

Ben / Irene / Lauren — looping you for pricing and legal guardrails. NarrowBand wants:
- Blended unit price breakdown across the staggered months;
- Sandbox burst bucket to be billed to a separate tag (fine by us, but procurement asked for cap per repo);
- Convert uplift to baseline at 75% utilization threshold instead of 100%;
- Split the $12k onboarding credit into two milestone invoices if possible.

My thinking / constraints:
- We can present a blended effective unit price that averages the staged rates and shows unit economics vs current rate. That helps their finance team justify it.
- For the baseline conversion, we can include a utilization clause: if average utilization of the uplifted units >= 75% over a 60-day measurement window, then annualize at that uplift for next year's base. This keeps us protected from short spikes.
- Sandbox: propose scoped tag + 250k token cap spread across dev teams, with automatic alerting at 80% usage. Billed if exceeded.
- Credit split: we can apportion the $12k as $7k on amendment execution, $5k after first full month of uplift usage.

Can you flag any legal or revenue recognition problems? If this is acceptable I will send a revised amendment with those points.

—Grace

Summary of changes:
- Blended price table included (page 2) showing effective unit price across the 50/30/20 stagger and comparison to current rate.
- Baseline conversion clause: conversion to next-year baseline occurs when uplift utilization >= 75% measured over a rolling 60-day window; conversion is capped at the uplift units agreed in the amendment.
- Sandbox burst: separated by billing tag, 250k token cap, automatic alerts at 80% with procurement notification.
- Onboarding credit: split $7k on execution, $5k after first full uplift month invoice.
- Minor legal: added a simple audit clause for usage verification; no change to termination or SLA language.
